dossier_rule: Preserve exact-compatible accepted Dossier evidence; do not re-research merely because the Deep architecture changes.

reusable_as_stage1_requires: all mandatory new Stage-1 structured fields can be mapped without semantic invention
all material positives/negatives/nuances have exact evidence grounding adequate for the new Stage-1 contract
a game-specific transparent point breakdown exists or can be deterministically mapped without resurrecting the forbidden fixed five-factor formula
provisional 0-56 score semantics are compatible with the holistic Stage-1 contract rather than copied from legacy fixed arithmetic
requires_stage1_reanalysis_if_any: mandatory Stage-1 structured evidence is missing

legacy score depends on fixed five-factor authority

legacy_deep_classification.preserved_evidence_rule: A row may require Stage-1 reanalysis while still preserving valid legacy findings as immutable migration/audit evidence. Requires reanalysis does not mean discard facts.

stage2_migration_rule: Only accepted Stage-1-compatible fit items become Stage-2 calibration candidates.
known_missing_score_findings_rule: Legacy fit results lacking score findings cannot become Stage-1-complete merely from their old numeric score; preserve factual evidence and classify under the same deterministic rules.

no_mixed_authority.before_cutover: Current FAST-DOSSIER-DEEP-V1 remains the only production ranking authority; new Stage-1/Stage-2 artifacts are non-authoritative.
no_mixed_authority.after_cutover: Only accepted Stage-2 calibrated fit + deterministic Wishlist + deterministic purchase may provide new positive semantic score authority. Legacy Deep/Fast numeric scores are audit history only.
